data.title: bn-370k: preserve Parquet timestamp UTC semantics
data.description: Review the 0.2.0 candidate WIT/API change, logical-vs-converted precedence, UTC true/local false fidelity across inspect/read-cell/read-column/read-rows, exact Lua bridge field shape, version consistency, unchanged resource limits/fail-closed behavior, deterministic fixture, and public 0.1.1 immutability.

data.reason: LGTM at 365f2ef3a08f1da6de2e5f2acfdb0916a462f325. Verified logical TIME/TIMESTAMP true and false survive inspect and all three read APIs; legacy converted annotations map explicitly to true; logical annotation precedence is enforced before converted fallback; non-temporal metadata remains absent; the production Sigil Lua bridge exposes exact is-adjusted-to-utc kebab-case. Full just check passed (28 unit tests + doc test, fmt, clippy, component build/validate); candidate-check passed 20/20 expectations with Sigil's local candidate runner. Bounds and fail-closed paths are unchanged and existing hostile/limit regressions passed. Version surfaces consistently identify unreleased 0.2.0. GitHub reports v0.1.1 immutable with original assets and no v0.2.0 tag/release exists.
